therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Resectable Stage cT2-T4a or N+ Gastric and GEJ Adenocarcinoma Overexpressing FGFR2b
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: efficacy of combination FLOT chemotherapy with bemarituzumab as perioperative treatment

results.dose_information: Bemarituzumab 15 mg/kg IV at C1D1 to C8D1 plus single additional dose of 7.5 mg/kg at C1D8, combined with FLOT regimen

context.investigator_commentary: Discontinuation of product manufacturing by the funder prior to the start of participant enrollment
